scope.policy: Pinned, vendored upstreams only. No install-time fetching, no GPL dependencies, no Gurobi/Java/Blossom-V runtime, QuadWild excluded by policy.

toolchain_evidence.compiler: Microsoft (R) C/C++ Optimizing Compiler for x64, version 19.50 (MSVC 14.50.35717)

components.name: Eigen
components.role: Dense/linear algebra backbone for TinyAD + libSatsuma numerics
components.notes: Header-only, 3.4.0. Used via vendor/eigen/Eigen/... include. MPL-2.0 requires EIGEN_MPL2_ONLY build flag for permissive downstream use; the flag is a no-op for internal use of this workspace but MUST be set in any compiled downstream artefact that links TinyAD/Eigen to keep downstream relicensing freedom.

components.name: TinyAD
components.role: Automatic differentiation (scalar + vector reverse/forward mode) for gradient-based quad optimisation loops
components.notes: Header-only. ScalarFunction<1,double>, x_from_data, eval_with_gradient verified by smoke/tinyad_smoke.cc (PASS).

components.name: libSatsuma
components.role: Bipartite matching, min-cost flow, reduction chain for quad-dominant mesh assignment
components.upstream_url: verified by archive pin (SHA-256); canonical mirror not asserted

archive.url: (see archive pin; URL not re-asserted to avoid false attribution)

components.notes: Headers + LICENSE only. .cc implementation files are NOT vendored; the MCF path is exercised directly through LEMON's NetworkSimplex (the exact solver libSatsuma calls). Gurobi-backed solvers in Lib/.../Solvers/*Gurobi.hh are NOT used and NOT enabled.

components.name: libTimekeeper
components.role: Structured wall-clock + CPU time reporting for solver loops (deterministic, no side effects on results)
components.notes: Header-only. Windows/Posix clocks; no runtime dependencies.

components.name: Q-Morph
components.role: Reference-only: quad-morph operator used in prior research; vendored as a contract reference, NOT compiled into the smoke path at Q0
components.notes: Only the MIT LICENSE is vendored at Q0. Source files (quad-morph C++/Java) are not compiled into the smoke path. This keeps the GPL/QuadWild boundary unbreached and the smoke path to <3s.

components.name: LEMON
components.role: Combinatorial optimisation library; NetworkSimplex (min-cost flow) is the exact solver called by libSatsuma's MCF path
components.notes: Headers + bits/ + concepts/ + generated config.h + generated export.h. LP/MIP solvers are DISABLED in config.h so no Soplex/Clp/Glpk/Minlp runtime is pulled in. NetworkSimplex + ListDigraph + ArcMap/NodeMap are the entry points used by the smoke test.

exclusions.rationale: Policy in QUAD_FIRST_FULL_PROGRAMME.md: no GPL dependencies, no Gurobi/Java runtime, no QuadWild; install-time fetching banned.
